_meta.name: A & B walk-through frame (steel, 122 cm)
_meta.family: Walk-through frame 1.22 x 1.93 m, bay 1.83 m (Asian 4 ft frame)
_meta.note: Singapore H-frame (walk-through) scaffold, frames perpendicular to the wall, cross brace on both faces of every bay, two 500 mm catwalks per bay. Only the 1829 mm bay has a deck with a published weight, so the preset uses that bay alone. 'verified' = false everywhere.
sources: 116488627-Standard-scaffold-catalogue.pdf p.5 (printed 3): frames A 1001-A 1008 and catwalk A 1009 with weights
116488627-Standard-scaffold-catalogue.pdf p.6 (printed 4): guard rails G-27/29/32/31, cross braces A-xx (A/B/C and weight), guard rail post, jack base 600, base plate 42.7 mm
116488627-Standard-scaffold-catalogue.pdf p.7 (printed 5): erection sequence (cross brace in each span, arm lock, joint pin, catwalk, wall tie) and jacks AB-40/AB-60/AB-80 with max extension
466055934-Yew-Huat-Frame-Scaffold-Catalogue-pdf.pdf p.6: cross brace A14 1829 x 1219 = 4.2 kg (cross-check of the illegible A-14)
168261806-APAC-Scaffold-Formwork-Catalogue.pdf p.32: screw jack 4.85 kg, corner guard rail post 3.8 kg (estimates only)
changes: kind=frame, walk-through: frames perpendicular to the wall; cross braces on both faces of every bay (rules.brace_every_n_bays=1, brace_faces=2), as in the catalogue: 'cross brace - for fixing the main frame in each span' (p.7).

Width = frame width 1219 mm (A dimension, p.5; the engine subtracts the tube, so legs 1176 mm apart if 1219 is outside-to-outside - not stated). Leg tube 42.7 mm from the base plate 'BASE PLATE 42.7MM' (p.6).
Lift = open end frame 1930 (A 1001); compensation frames = the shorter 1219-wide frames 1700 (A 1002), 1524 (A 1003), 1219 (A 1007), 914 (A 1008).

Bay = 1829 only: the catwalk A 1009 (1829 x 500, 16 kg) is the only deck with a weight; metal planks 210/240 x 2000-4000 have no weight. Braces A-13 (1219) and A-11 (1524) are listed for reference but no deck exists for those bays.
Decks: 2 catwalks of 500 mm per bay (1000 mm in a 1219 frame).
Cross brace A-14 (1829 x 1219): weight poorly printed in the scan, read as 4.2 kg on a 400 dpi render; equals Yew Huat A14 (4.2 kg).
Guard rails G-31 1829 (1.7 kg): 2 per bay and deck level on the outside; end rail = 2 x G-32 1219 (2 x 1.2 kg).
Top-level guard rail post (1219 high, no code): weight not published; 3.8 kg estimated (APAC corner guard rail post).

Base jacks: AB-40 (400 mm, max ext 250) and AB-60 (600 mm, max ext 450) from p.7; weights not published: 4.85 kg estimated for both (APAC screw jack, length not stated). NOTE: the engine does not mark jack rows as estimated in the BOM.
No access deck with hatch (only a step/ladder 1829 x 1725 without weight): access list empty, the engine places no access deck and warns.
Toeboards and end toeboards: not in the catalogue, estimated at rules.toeboard_est_kg_per_m = 2.0 kg/m.
Ties: 'wall tie (keeper joint)' named without weight or spacing; tie 2.9 kg, coupler 0.63 kg (Yew Huat fixed clamp), eyebolt 0.2 kg estimated.

system.load_note: No platform load class published; jacks SWL 40-45 kN (safety factor 3.5)
system.connection: joint pin between frames, arm lock against uplift, cross braces on frame lock pins, catwalk hooks on the frame head tube
